diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed that only connectivity to/from web1 (10.10.40.10) was failing while other routed paths were healthy. Reads showed web1 had 10.10.40.10/24 configured but no default route, whereas peer hosts had correct defaults and leaf2 had the DMZ gateway 10.10.40.1/24 configured. I added web1's default route via 10.10.40.1. Final public success criteria validation passed, with all listed connectivity checks succeeding.
diagnosis.reference: On web1, the default route (0.0.0.0/0) was removed, so it has no route to other networks.

arguments.name: ethernet-1/40
arguments.reason: Validation shows only paths to/from web1 (10.10.40.0/24) fail while other routed paths succeed; leaf1 running config lacks the DMZ-facing gateway/subinterface and leaf1 state shows ethernet-1/40 disabled/down, indicating the DMZ segment is attached to the wrong leaf and needs its access interface enabled to restore 10.10.40.0/24 reachability without changing healthy paths.

arguments.name: default
arguments.reason: web1 is the only affected endpoint subnet and its route table lacks any default route, while peer hosts on other VLANs all have a default gateway and leaf2 has 10.10.40.1 configured on the DMZ-facing interface. This matches a host-side routing fault causing web1 to report 'Network unreachable' for return traffic.
